main_topics.reason: User came overwhelmed by food lists and most of the conversation covers phases, food lists, elimination and reintroduction.
User's stated main problem was contradictory online lists and asked how to know what is high FODMAP.
User asked over several turns how to do reintroduction properly and whether to do it alone.
User asked whether the app was worth paying for given skepticism of health apps.
User asked about getting a dietitian and whether the NHS covers it, and adopted it as part of the plan.
User worried about giving up onion and garlic forever and felt relieved at the answer.
User asked in one exchange whether elimination would leave them starving.

output.summary: A user with IBS told to try low FODMAP by their gastro felt overwhelmed by contradictory food lists. The bot explained the temporary three-phase structure, recommended a trusted app, covered reintroduction and suggested asking the GP for an NHS dietitian referral. The user restated a clear plan and said it was far more helpful than hours of googling.
